title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision
summary_en: Alternates evolutionary multi-agent workflow search and supervised fine-tuning on self-generated trajectories; the updated model also proposes and evaluates workflows.
summary_zh: 交替进行多智能体工作流进化与自生成轨迹 SFT，更新后的模型继续承担提出、执行与评估角色。
evidence_boundary: The abstract reports two cycles; this does not establish indefinite or universal improvement.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 摘要报告了两轮循环，不能据此推断无限持续改进或所有领域都受益。

title: Gödel Forest: Balancing Search Depth and Breadth for Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement
update_target: Data strategies + shared memory + target weights
summary_en: Uses persistent search trees and shared procedural lessons to coordinate agents exploring training-data strategies.
summary_zh: 多智能体分别维护持久搜索树，通过共享程序性经验协同探索训练数据策略。
evidence_boundary: Distinguish improvements to the target model from improvements to the research agents themselves.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 需要区分目标模型的进步与研究智能体自身改进能力的进步。

title: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement
summary_en: Refines harness specifications using pairwise feedback over revision history, emphasizing context management and inter-agent information flow.
summary_zh: 利用历史版本间的成对反馈优化提示层 harness，重点涉及上下文管理与智能体间信息流。
evidence_boundary: Harness optimization is demonstrated; do not infer completed multi-round model/harness co-training.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 已展示的是 harness 优化，不能推断已完成多轮模型与 harness 联合训练。

title: Multi-Agent Evolve: LLM Self-Improve through Co-evolution
summary_en: Co-evolves proposer, solver and judge roles instantiated from one LLM through reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: 由同一 LLM 实例化出题、求解、裁判角色，以强化学习实现多角色共进化。
evidence_boundary: Role co-training is closely related to MARSI; separately test whether the improvement operator becomes better.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 多角色共训练与 MARSI 密切相关，但改进器是否变强需要单独验证。

title: Skill-MAS: Evolving Meta-Skill for Automatic Multi-Agent Systems
summary_en: Distills experience from multiple trajectories into a reusable orchestration meta-skill through selective reflection.
summary_zh: 从多轨迹中选择性反思，积累可迁移的编排 Meta-Skill，将经验保留与参数更新解耦。
evidence_boundary: Persistent orchestration knowledge does not alone demonstrate an improving optimizer.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 编排知识持续积累，本身不足以证明优化器的改进能力增强。

title: HELIX: Model-Harness Co-evolution for Recursive Self-Improvement
summary_en: Tracks harness interventions and sibling trajectories to connect harness evolution with future model training.
summary_zh: 对 harness 组件、干预和兄弟轨迹进行溯源，为模型训练保留可验证数据。
evidence_boundary: The abstract evaluates one evolution round; sustained co-evolution remains a stronger claim.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 摘要仅评估一轮演化，持续共进化属于更强的待验证主张。

title: Recursive self-improvement of AI research agents
summary_en: Rewrites and evaluates its own research-agent code, with accepted versions becoming the subject of later improvement.
summary_zh: 研究智能体修改自身代码，经评估接受的版本成为下一轮改进对象，并考察跨任务迁移。
evidence_boundary: A self-modification reference; not inherently a multi-agent collaboration method.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 属于自身代码修改的重要参照，并不天然等同于多智能体协作方法。

title: Darwin Godel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
summary_en: Combines self-modifying coding agents with an archive and open-ended evolutionary exploration.
summary_zh: 结合智能体自身代码修改、进化档案与开放式探索，保存可继续演化的候选。
evidence_boundary: A population/archive is not automatically a collaborating multi-agent team within a task.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 种群或档案中的多个候选，不自动等于单个任务内协作的多智能体团队。

title: A Self-Improving Coding Agent
summary_en: Lets a coding agent edit its own implementation and evaluates the resulting agents on coding tasks.
summary_zh: 允许编码智能体编辑自身实现，并在编码任务上检验修改后的能力。
evidence_boundary: Useful code-level self-improvement baseline; multi-agent coordination is not the central mechanism.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 适合作为代码级自我改进基线，多智能体协调并非其核心机制。

title: Gödel Agent: A Self-Referential Agent Framework for Recursive Self-Improvement
summary_en: Lets an agent dynamically change its own logic and behavior under high-level objectives.
summary_zh: 让智能体在高层目标指导下动态修改自身逻辑与行为，是自指式改进的重要参照。
evidence_boundary: Runtime self-modification and stable cross-task recursive gains should be assessed separately.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 运行时自身修改与稳定的跨任务递归增益需要分开检验。

title: Self-Adapting Language Models
summary_en: Learns to generate adaptation data and update directives using downstream post-update performance as feedback.
summary_zh: 根据更新后的下游表现，学习生成适应数据及更新指令，连接自生成监督与权重更新。
evidence_boundary: Self-adaptation mechanism, not a multi-agent RSI system by itself.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 属于模型自适应机制，单独使用并不构成多智能体 RSI 系统。

title: MAS-ZERO: Designing Multi-Agent Systems with Zero Supervision
summary_en: Designs and revises multi-agent configurations at inference time using meta-feedback without a validation set.
summary_zh: 在单个问题的推理过程中依据元反馈设计、批判并修订多智能体配置。
evidence_boundary: Instance-level adaptation does not by itself imply persistent cross-task inheritance.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 问题实例内的自适应，并不自动意味着持久的跨任务继承。

title: EvoFlow: Evolving Diverse Agentic Workflows On The Fly
summary_en: Evolves diverse heterogeneous workflows through retrieval, crossover, mutation and niching selection.
summary_zh: 通过检索、交叉、变异和生态位选择，维护异构且复杂度可变的工作流种群。
evidence_boundary: Workflow evolution is related to RSI but does not establish recursive optimizer improvement.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 工作流演化与 RSI 相关，但并未因此证明优化器递归变强。

title: Multi-Agent Design: Optimizing Agents with Better Prompts and Topologies
summary_en: Optimizes local prompts, workflow topology and global prompts in staged multi-agent system search.
summary_zh: 分阶段优化局部提示、工作流拓扑及全局提示，适合作为自动团队设计基线。
evidence_boundary: Multi-Agent System Search; a different paper from Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (2026).
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 此处 MASS 指 Multi-Agent System Search，与 2026 年的 Multi-Agent Self-Supervision 不同。

title: AFlow: Automating Agentic Workflow Generation
summary_en: Searches code-represented workflows with Monte Carlo tree search and execution feedback.
summary_zh: 使用蒙特卡洛树搜索与执行反馈优化代码表示的工作流。
evidence_boundary: A workflow-search baseline; do not equate better workflows with a stronger optimizer.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 可作为工作流搜索基线，工作流变好不能直接等同于优化器变强。

title: Automated Design of Agentic Systems
summary_en: A meta-agent programs new agent designs using an expanding archive of earlier discoveries.
summary_zh: 元智能体参考不断扩展的设计档案，以代码生成和搜索新的智能体系统。
evidence_boundary: Automated agent design can use a fixed designer; distinguish it from designer self-improvement.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 自动设计可以由固定设计者完成，应与设计者自身改进区分。

title: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls into Self-Improving Pipelines
summary_en: Compiles declarative language-model programs against a task metric to optimize pipeline behavior.
summary_zh: 将声明式语言模型程序编译为按任务指标优化的流程，为模块化优化提供基础。
evidence_boundary: General optimization infrastructure, not evidence of multi-agent recursive improvement.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 属于通用优化基础设施，不是多智能体递归改进的直接证据。

title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
summary_en: Builds and retrieves an expanding library of executable skills with curriculum and environment feedback.
summary_zh: 结合自动课程、环境反馈与可执行技能库，持续获取并复用技能。
evidence_boundary: An embodied single-agent inheritance reference, not a MARSI system.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 属于具身单智能体的技能继承参照，不是 MARSI 系统。

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Stores verbal reflections on feedback to improve decisions in subsequent trials without weight updates.
summary_zh: 将任务反馈转化为文字反思并保存到情景记忆，用于后续尝试。
evidence_boundary: Trial-level reflection is not sufficient evidence of optimizer-level recursion.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 尝试之间的反思不足以单独证明改进器层面的递归增强。

title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
summary_en: Iteratively generates feedback and revises an output using the same language model.
summary_zh: 利用同一模型循环生成反馈并修订当前答案，是单次输出改进的基础对照。
evidence_boundary: Output refinement; no persistent system update is implied.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 改善的是当前输出，不意味着持久的系统更新。

title: Mixture-of-Agents Enhances Large Language Model Capabilities
summary_en: Aggregates outputs across layers of multiple language-model agents.
summary_zh: 通过多层智能体输出聚合发挥多个模型的互补能力。
evidence_boundary: Collaboration at inference time does not imply self-evolution.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 推理时协作并不意味着系统会自我演化。

title: AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation
summary_en: Provides configurable agent conversations and tool/human interaction for multi-agent applications.
summary_zh: 提供可配置的多智能体对话、工具与人类交互机制。
evidence_boundary: Framework infrastructure; no recursive learning mechanism is implied by its use.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 属于框架基础设施，使用该框架不自动带来递归学习机制。

title: MetaGPT: Meta Programming for A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework
summary_en: Structures collaboration through role specialization and standard operating procedures.
summary_zh: 通过角色分工与标准操作流程组织多智能体协作。
evidence_boundary: A structured collaboration baseline, not itself an RSI algorithm.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 适合作为结构化协作基线，本身不是 RSI 算法。

title: Improving Factuality and Reasoning in Language Models through Multiagent Debate
summary_en: Uses multiple model instances to exchange and revise reasoning over rounds of debate.
summary_zh: 让多个模型实例在多轮辩论中交换并修订推理与答案。
evidence_boundary: Debate rounds concern an answer, not necessarily inheritable system changes.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 多轮辩论主要作用于当前答案，不一定产生可继承的系统变化。

title: RSIBench-Data: Benchmarking Data-Centric Research for Recursive Self-Improvement
summary_en: Benchmarks diagnosis, training-data strategy revision and checkpoint-feedback use with a controlled post-training stack.
summary_zh: 在固定后训练基础设施上评测能力诊断、训练数据策略修改与检查点反馈利用。
evidence_boundary: Repeated feedback can guide development; reserve separate final evaluation to assess generalization.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 反复反馈可用于开发，检验泛化时仍应保留独立的最终评测。

title: SEA-Eval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Evolving Agents Beyond Episodic Assessment
summary_en: Evaluates self-evolving agents on task streams, tracking success, token use and evolution over time.
summary_zh: 使用序列任务流评测跨任务经验积累，关注成功率、token 开销与演化轨迹。
evidence_boundary: Sequential gains do not alone isolate improvement of the optimizer.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 序列任务上的增益，不能单独识别优化器自身是否改进。

title: Terminal-Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hard, Realistic Tasks in Command Line Interfaces
summary_en: Tests agents in realistic terminal environments with task-specific verification.
summary_zh: 以具体验证测试评估智能体在真实终端环境中的长链路任务执行。
evidence_boundary: Task-performance anchor; not a dedicated multi-agent RSI benchmark.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 属于任务表现的评测锚点，不是专门的多智能体 RSI 基准。

title: MLR-Bench: Evaluating AI Agents on Open-Ended Machine Learning Research
summary_en: Evaluates research stages and end-to-end ML research with a rubric-based review framework.
summary_zh: 评测开放式机器学习研究的多个阶段及端到端交付，使用结构化审稿量表。
evidence_boundary: Audit execution evidence and judge reliability; generated reports alone are insufficient.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 需要核查执行证据与评分器可靠性，仅生成研究报告并不足够。

title: ScienceAgentBench: Toward Rigorous Assessment of Language Agents for Data-Driven Scientific Discovery
summary_en: Uses publication-grounded scientific tasks with executable Python deliverables and cost-aware evaluation.
summary_zh: 以真实论文中的科学任务为基础，评价 Python 交付物、执行结果和成本。
evidence_boundary: Check the exact dataset version and artifacts when comparing published results.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 比较论文结果前，应确认具体数据集版本和配套评测资产。

title: DSBench: How Far Are Data Science Agents from Becoming Data Science Experts?
summary_en: Covers realistic data-analysis and modeling tasks with large files and multimodal context.
summary_zh: 覆盖大文件、多表和多模态上下文下的数据分析与建模任务。
evidence_boundary: Report analysis and modeling separately; they have different task and metric structures.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 分析与建模的任务结构和指标不同，建议分别报告。

title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
summary_en: Evaluates code changes for real repository issues using executable tests.
summary_zh: 用真实仓库问题及可执行测试检验代码修改能力。
evidence_boundary: Distinguish original, Lite, Verified and other variants; this entry cites the original paper.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 区分原版、Lite、Verified 等版本；此条引用的是原始论文。

title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
summary_en: Evaluates reasoning and decision-making across diverse interactive environments.
summary_zh: 跨多种交互式环境评测智能体的推理与决策能力。
evidence_boundary: An agent-evaluation foundation rather than a dedicated recursive-improvement protocol.
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
evidence_boundary_zh: 属于通用智能体评测基础，不是专门的递归改进协议。

title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems via Decentralized Memory
summary_en: Gives each agent exploitation and exploration memory pools, reweighted using staged judge feedback.
summary_zh: 每个智能体维护利用与探索两个记忆池，依据阶段性评价反馈调整权重，以保留独立经验与多样性。
evidence_boundary: Memory adaptation does not alone demonstrate that the improvement procedure itself improves.
evidence_boundary_zh: 记忆自适应并不单独证明改进流程本身变强。
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present

title: HarnessForge: Joint Harness and Policy Evolution for Adaptive Agent Systems
summary_en: Co-evolves execution structure and reasoning policy through fault-guided harness tailoring and harness-conditioned policy alignment.
summary_zh: 通过故障驱动的 harness 调整和以 harness 为条件的策略对齐，联合演化执行结构与推理策略。
evidence_boundary: Joint system adaptation is relevant to RSI; sustained optimizer improvement requires separate evidence.
evidence_boundary_zh: 联合适应与 RSI 相关，但持续的改进器能力提升仍需单独证据。
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present

title: MANTA: Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation for Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
summary_en: Initializes a topology from structural experience and applies bounded role, communication and validation updates during execution.
summary_zh: 利用已有结构经验初始化拓扑，并在执行中有界调整角色、通信、顺序、信息可见性与验证路径。
evidence_boundary: Inference-time structural adaptation is not automatically persistent recursive optimizer improvement.
evidence_boundary_zh: 推理时结构自适应不自动等于持久的改进器递归增强。
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present

title: MILO: Automated Harness Discovery via Orchestrated Multi-Agent Evolution
summary_en: Combines island-based lineage memory, mutator agents and an orchestrator that adapts the search organization and curriculum.
summary_zh: 结合岛屿谱系记忆、修改智能体与编排器，同时演化完整 harness 及其发现策略，并利用被拒绝变异作为负面证据。
evidence_boundary: Distinguish co-adaptation of search from demonstrated transferable improvement in the optimizer under matched budgets.
evidence_boundary_zh: 需要在匹配预算下区分搜索的共同适应与改进器可迁移的能力提升。
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present

title: Inherit-MAS: Test-Time Evolution of Multi-Agent Systems through Workflow and Execution Inheritance
summary_en: Refines workflows through validated edits and reuses stored execution results only when resolved requests and contexts match.
summary_zh: 通过经验证的编辑继承并修订工作流，仅在完整请求与执行上下文匹配时复用结果，减少重复执行。
evidence_boundary: Execution caching and test-time workflow refinement do not establish cross-task improvement of the optimizer.
evidence_boundary_zh: 执行结果缓存和测试时工作流修订，不证明跨任务改进器能力提升。
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present

title: RSI-Forge: From Research Papers to Environments for Recursive Self-Improvement
summary_en: Uses construction, reproduction and review agents to turn papers into executable research tasks and evaluates repeated attempts with inherited code and notes.
summary_zh: 通过构建、复现与审查智能体，将论文转为可执行研究环境；评测继承代码和笔记后的连续改进尝试。
evidence_boundary: An environment-construction and evaluation resource; repeated solution gains with frozen weights do not alone establish optimizer recursion.
evidence_boundary_zh: 主要贡献是环境构建与评测；固定权重下连续解题提升不足以单独证明改进器递归增强。
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present

title: Evolve Together, Fall into Place: How Social Scaffolding Shapes Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
summary_en: Studies how team composition and collaboration, conformity or competition shape the outcomes of agent evolution.
summary_zh: 分别改变团队构成与协作、从众、竞争等关系，研究社会组织方式如何影响团队演化及领导权分配。
evidence_boundary: A study of conditions for team evolution, not evidence that every evolving team improves or becomes more decentralized.
evidence_boundary_zh: 研究团队演化的条件，不代表所有演化团队都会进步或趋于去中心化。
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present

title: Learning to Compose: Recursive Self-Improvement of Shared Executable Stacks for Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
update_target: Shared tools, skill contracts and verifiers
summary_en: Improves a persistent executable stack using failure attribution, component repair and selection/regression gates, then freezes it for transfer.
summary_zh: 对共享工具、技能契约、交接与验证器组成的执行栈进行故障归因、修复和回归筛选，再冻结用于新任务迁移。
evidence_boundary: A robot-programming transfer reference; shared components are not themselves a collaborating multi-agent system.
evidence_boundary_zh: 属于机器人编程与迁移参照；共享组件本身不等于协作的多智能体系统。
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present

title: EvolveMAS: A Unified Self-Evolution Framework for Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems
summary_en: Pairs agents with MemoryAgents and combines within-episode memory updates with cross-episode distillation of partner profiles and interaction strategies.
summary_zh: 为主智能体配置 MemoryAgent，结合回合内记忆治理与跨回合伙伴画像、交互策略提炼，支持合作及对抗场景。
evidence_boundary: Parameter-free experience evolution does not by itself isolate improvement of the memory-update or optimization procedure.
evidence_boundary_zh: 无参数更新的经验演化，并不单独识别记忆更新机制或优化流程自身是否变强。
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present

title: Skill∞: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Skill Optimization
summary_en: Uses a meta-skill to optimize task skills and applies the same procedure to that meta-skill, including diagnosis, review and budget allocation.
summary_zh: 元智能体按 Meta-Skill 优化任务技能，再用同一流程优化 Meta-Skill 本身，允许修改诊断、审查和预算分配步骤。
evidence_boundary: Directly targets the improvement procedure; broad sustained gains and the contribution of multi-agent collaboration require separate evaluation.
evidence_boundary_zh: 直接面向改进流程自身；广泛持续收益及多智能体协作的独立贡献仍需另行检验。
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present

title: EvoTeam: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Teams
update_target: Reusable teams + interaction rules + agent skills
summary_en: Maintains a team library and jointly evolves team organization, team-specific interaction rules and skills reusable across teams.
summary_zh: 维护可复用团队库，联合演化团队组织、团队专属交互规则及跨团队可复用的个体技能。
evidence_boundary: Collaboration-level evolution is central, but recursive improvement of the evolution operator is a stronger separate claim.
evidence_boundary_zh: 核心是协作层面的演化，演化算子自身递归变强是更强的独立主张。
verification: arXiv abstract-page metadata and abstract; code link verified with GitHub API when present
